title: Working from a basket? You need special training
lines: Even with a work-at-height permit, you need special training to work from a basket.
We learn in class, then practice in the field, each person on their own.
How to clip in, where to stand, and what not to do up there.
That way the operator is at ease, and so are you.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. Crane and training in one place.
disclaimer: This video is not official training|and does not replace training and hands-on practice|and is not a work-at-height permit|a reminder only
